messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: pager fired -> PagerDuty alert: service=redwood-inference-hosted api=inference-api metric=p99_latency threshold=1200ms current=1720ms

Alex (oncall): seen. ACKing and grabbing bridge. paging details: https://pd.example/INC12345

incident-bot: auto-escalation in 2m if unacked by senior oncall

Maria G: thanks. I'm pulling charts and recent deploys. any recent rollout?

Alex (oncall): no deploys in last 30m according to deploy-bot. rolling spike, looks regional (eu-west) from traces.

Sam K: adding notes from console: tokenization queue p95 jumped, and kvcache hit-rate dropped ~40% -> more cold starts.

Priya R: could be a hot-key or large batch causing downstream backpressure. checking kinesis/backpressure metrics.

SRE Duty: customer-impact check: internal alert says some long-chat completions are timing out (timeouts -> 504 at client side). paging severity elevated.

Alex (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) scale inference-pool-dedicated eu-west +20% (manual) 2) enable fallback routing to compatible quantized-model-3 for non-critical routes 3) warm prefixes for top 5 hot endpoints. Doing step 1 now.

Maria G: started scale; pods coming up (logs: "added 6 inference workers to pool eu-west").

Sam K: running quick kvcache warm script:
```bash
# warm top prefixes from recent traces
python tools/warm_kvcache.py --service inference-api --region eu-west --top 5
```
Started - will report back when done.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: alert auto-escalated to Maria G after 2 minutes due to p99 still > threshold

Maria G: acked and now on bridge. observed error budget burn ~7% over 10m. if we don't see p99 drop in 5m, recommend model-swap fallback.

Priya R: warming showed heavy skew: single customer client-id X-123 accounts for ~18% of traffic and has many large-concat prompts. throttling that key for 3m to reduce tail.

Alex (oncall): throttled client X-123 at edge rate limiter. reporting immediate effect: p99 down to ~980ms within 90s. :thumbsup:

SRE Duty: customer-impact update: no widespread 5xxs after throttle; a handful of long calls still time out but overall degraded state improving. advise keep throttle and continue warming.

Sam K: kvcache warm finished. hitrate back to ~78% from 40%. KV eviction logs show hotkey flood earlier.

Maria G: proceeding with controlled model-swap on non-sensitive traffic to quantized-model-3 as precaution. will route only 10% traffic and ramp.

Alex (oncall): deployed route rule:
```yaml
- match: route in [embeddings, batch-generate]
  action: divert -> quantized-model-3
  percent: 10
```
Rolling now.

incident-bot: Note: automated rollback will trigger if error_rate > 0.5% or latency p99 > 1500ms for 2 consecutive minutes.

Maria G: initial 10% ramp looks good. p99 continues to trend down. keeping on bridge for 15m then handoff.

Priya R: rebalanced autoscaler hysteresis to be more aggressive for short spikes. set min_replicas +2 for 10m window.

Alex (oncall): summary to customers in case we need to notify: "We experienced a regional latency degradation affecting some chat and embedding requests in EU-West between HH:MM and ongoing; mitigations include autoscaling, kvcache warming, and targeted client throttling. We're monitoring." Ready for draft if needed.

Sam K: telemetry shows p95 back to normal, p99 around 950ms, error rate <0.1%. Looks stable for 4m.

incident-bot: alert resolved: p99_latency returned below threshold for 3m; PagerDuty incident auto-resolved.

Alex (oncall): resolving bridge in 10m, will handoff to next oncall for post-incident follow-up. thanks all. :pray:

Maria G: filing postmortem note and adding customer impact blurb. will include reproducer and mitigation steps (throttle pattern + kvcache warm playbook).

Priya R: leaving follow-up action: explore per-customer prefix warm gating and rate-limiter defaults to avoid hot-client floods.

Sam K: add a small smoke test to detect kv hit-rate drops earlier. PR incoming.

Alex (oncall): final: handoff to next oncall @Sam K at 19:00 UTC. thread closed after postmortem created.
